movers.quantum: Rs 16.51 cr settling Rs 33.39 cr; ~11.2% of mcap
movers.headline: settles SILRES's insolvency petition against **Sherisha Solar by paying Rs 16.51 crore against a Rs 33.39 crore loan liability**, and sells Ishaan Solar for Rs 3.93 crore
reports that **MSEDCL has encashed a Rs 6.65 crore bank guarantee** on its 133 MW solar award after MERC vacated interim protection, an equal adverse financial impact

order_wins: **Juniper Green Energy** — a letter of award from **SECI for 230 MW of firm and dispatchable round-the-clock renewable capacity** at a tariff of **Rs 5.26 per unit**, to be commissioned within 24 months on a 25-year PPA, with no contract value stated.

**Hazoor Multi Projects also filed the identical rupee figure yesterday** — Rs 28.47 crore for the Thirupapachethi plaza on NH-49 in Tamil Nadu — so two separate NHAI toll-collection awards, in two states, are sized to the same lakh.

**DMR Engineering** — a **revised** intimation correcting yesterday's letter on its **Rs 1.66 crore, eight-year** project-management appointment for the 1,500 MW Tarali pumped storage project, now naming its consortium rather than Adani Renewable Energy One.
m_and_a: **RPG Life Sciences** — completes the **slump sale of its Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients business to RPG Active Pharma**, a wholly owned subsidiary, with effect from today under the business transfer agreement signed on 29 July.

**RPG Life Sciences** — separately subscribes **Rs 65.69 crore** to that subsidiary's rights issue, 21,89,535 shares allotted on 14 August, after which its holding is **unchanged at 100%**, so no capital enters the group _(~1.4% of mcap)_.

**Rajesh Power Services** — incorporates **Rajesh Power Services NZ**, a 100% wholly owned New Zealand subsidiary for electrical and solar EPC work, with the subscription amount left to the incorporation documents and no consideration stated.
capex_core: **Sanginita Chemicals — the day's largest number, on a company worth Rs 326 crore.** Its wholly owned Agastya Green Energy announced a **Rs 7,800 crore, 12 GW ingot and wafer plant at Kurnool** _(~2,394% of mcap)_, with no financing disclosed.
business_updates: **Results season, and on a holiday tape it is most of what moved** — **13 companies filed results or earnings-call material**, including **Greenpanel Industries**, **Indraprastha Gas**, **Saatvik Green Energy** and **NMDC Steel**.

**Markolines Pavement Technologies** — June-quarter revenue of **Rs 75.86 crore**, EBITDA up **8.7%** and profit after tax up **15.1% to Rs 4.36 crore**, against a stated order book of **over Rs 550 crore**.

**Jinkushal Industries** — standalone June-quarter revenue up **37.4% to Rs 5,129.42 lakh** and consolidated revenue up **15.9% to Rs 5,656.55 lakh**, which the company attributes to inventory positioning and wider international presence.

**Ritco Logistics** — reports a June quarter delivered *despite* Middle East disruption to its petrochemical customers, with PSU plants shut or at half capacity, and says it retained its **CRISIL A-** rating.

**M M Forgings** — clarifies that the **Rs 56.25 crore exceptional item, net of tax**, in its June-quarter results is **profit on the sale of land near Oragadam, Chennai** during the quarter, not an operating gain _(~2.0% of mcap)_.
distress_risk: **Aban Offshore** — the auditors issue a **disclaimer of opinion**, unable to obtain bank confirmations for **Rs 59.30 crore of deposits and Rs 414.80 crore of term borrowings** at 31 March 2026, against a market value of Rs 108 crore.

**Eureka Industries** — the NCLT Ahmedabad admitted the company's **own petition under Section 54C** on 14 August, commencing a **pre-packaged insolvency resolution process** with the board remaining in control of the company.

**Sterlite Technologies — a win, not a loss.** The Delhi High Court dismissed the Department of Telecommunications' challenge, upholding the award that quashed a **Rs 8.56 crore** demand, leaving *zero financial or operational exposure*.

**Indian Hume Pipe** — the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) confirmed a **Rs 63.11 lakh penalty** for assessment year 2023-24, levied on alleged unexplained purchases of **Rs 10.52 crore** while the quantum appeal is still pending before the ITAT.

**India Power Corporation** — also convenes the **fourth meeting of its committee of creditors** for 17 August, to note the June-quarter results and the resolution professional's continuing review of a 2025 business transfer agreement.
other_notable: **Ola Electric** — launches a **battery energy storage portfolio**, Ola Shakti for homes, Shakti Rack for commercial and industrial use and Mahashakti for utility scale, built on its own cell and pack capability, with no pricing disclosed.

**Mahindra & Mahindra** — Mahindra Electric introduces the **BE 6 SPORTEQ starting at Rs 11.45 lakh** under a **battery-as-a-service** plan, with the battery charged separately at **Rs 3.75 per kilometre**.

**P N Gadgil Jewellers** opened a **3,500 sq ft** store in Gurugram, which its release calls an entry into Delhi NCR, and **HFCL's** row is a schedule for the Motilal Oswal investor conference on 18 August rather than a press release.

tally: 2026-08-15: 465 announcements captured (00:01–23:59 IST) on **Independence Day, a Saturday** — **325 of them newspaper publications** and only 41 material — with **5 verified movers**. The thinnest tape this module has polished, and the baseline's three movers all fail: **RPG Life Sciences' Rs 65.69 crore goes into its own wholly owned subsidiary and leaves the holding at 100%**, and **DMR Engineering's Rs 1.66 crore is a revised re-filing of yesterday's order**. What actually happened was distress and one acquisition. **The Department of Telecommunications encashed Rs 801.91 crore of Reliance Communications' spectrum bank guarantees across four banks** — the day's largest figure, and the store held none of it. **UPL agreed to buy Egypt's Misr Hytech Seed International for about US$110 million**, taking 99.98% through Advanta by January 2027. **Refex Renewables settled an insolvency petition against Sherisha Solar for Rs 16.51 crore against a Rs 33.39 crore liability**, **MSEDCL encashed a Rs 6.65 crore guarantee from India Power mid-CIRP**, and **Hazoor Multi Projects won a Rs 28.47 crore NHAI toll-collection award** — the identical sum it filed yesterday for a different plaza in a different state. Held back deliberately: **Sanginita Chemicals' Rs 7,800 crore solar project is 2,394% of its market value**, and **Aban Offshore's Rs 414.80 crore is an auditor's disclaimer, not a deal**.
